scientific_integrity: A complete conditional-probability proof and a standalone 97-case rational enumeration are included; exact computations check but do not replace the proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-hypergraph stochastic synchronous model; exact two-step covariance at the original uniquely co-infected source, with equal pathogen parameters and r=2. Not a statement about asymptotic prevalence, observational data, arbitrary initial laws, or alternative reinfection conventions.
title: A sharp recovery threshold reverses cross-pathogen covariance in synchronous hypergraph SIS
